title: Wire DoseRow's new onClick to open the edit dialog
description: DoseRow now requires an onClick parameter (task-010). Tapping a row opens the edit-dose dialog for that specific dose.
acceptance_criteria: The call becomes DoseRow(medicationName = medicationName, doseLog = doseLog, onClick = { editingDoseLog = doseLog })
exact_code: DoseRow(medicationName = medicationName, doseLog = doseLog, onClick = { editingDoseLog = doseLog })
